info.name: AI360 ExpressPay Provider Verification
info.description: Provider-level verification for ExpressPay hosted checkout in sandbox or live. Select the matching environment before running. This collection never submits card or Mobile Money credentials and cannot complete a charge by itself.

exec: if (!['sandbox', 'live'].includes(target)) throw new Error('Select an AI360 ExpressPay sandbox or live environment.');
if (origin !== expectedOrigin) throw new Error('Environment mismatch: expected ' + expectedOrigin + ' for ' + target + '.');
throw new Error('LIVE TEST BLOCKED: set live_confirmation to YES_I_UNDERSTAND only after ExpressPay confirms live credentials and your current IP is allowlisted.');
if (!isIpCheck && (!pm.environment.get('merchant_id') || !pm.environment.get('api_key'))) throw new Error('Add the matching ExpressPay merchant_id and api_key as secret environment values.');
if (!isIpCheck && !/^https:\/\//.test(pm.environment.get('app_origin') || '')) throw new Error('app_origin must be a public HTTPS origin.');

item.name: 0 - Show this Postman runner's public IP

exec:
pm.visualizer.set('

Postman outbound IP

{{ip}}

Ask ExpressPay whether this exact IP is allowlisted for the selected {{target}} merchant. This is not necessarily the Hostinger server IP.

', { ip: body.ip, target: pm.environment.get('target_environment') });

request.description: Shows the public IP used by the selected Postman runner. ExpressPay may need to allowlist this IP separately from Hostinger.

exec: pm.test('ExpressPay accepted the credentials, payload and source IP', () => {
pm.expect(body.status, body.status === 4 ? 'Status 4 means this runtime IP must be allowlisted by ExpressPay' : body.message).to.eql(1);
pm.test('ExpressPay echoed the exact AI360 order ID', () => pm.expect(body['order-id']).to.eql(pm.environment.get('order_id')));

const safe = { outcome: body.status === 1 ? 'PASS' : 'BLOCKED', providerStatus: body.status, message: body.message || 'No message', orderId: body['order-id'] || pm.environment.get('order_id'), nextStep: body.status === 4 ? 'Ask ExpressPay to allowlist the staging server egress IP.' : 'Run request 2 to query the new token.' };

pm.visualizer.set('

ExpressPay {{environment}} Submit

{{outcome}}

Endpoint
{{origin}}/api/submit.php
Provider status
{{providerStatus}}
Message
{{message}}
Order
{{orderId}}
Next step
{{nextStep}}

No API key or checkout token is displayed in this evidence view.

', { ...safe, environment: pm.environment.get('target_environment'), origin: pm.environment.get('expresspay_origin'), className: safe.outcome === 'PASS' ? 'pass' : 'blocked' });

request.description: Creates a low-value hosted checkout in the selected environment. It does not submit payment credentials or complete a payment. A live submit creates a real live order and token even when checkout is not completed.

exec: throw new Error('Run request 1 successfully before querying a token.');
pm.test('ExpressPay Query responded over HTTP', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Query returned a documented payment state', () => pm.expect([1, 2, 3, 4]).to.include(Number(body.result)));
pm.test('Query matched the configured GHS test amount', () => { pm.expect(body.currency).to.eql('GHS'); pm.expect(Number(body.amount)).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('test_amount'))); });
if (Number(body.result) === 1) pm.test('Approved payment has a transaction ID', () => pm.expect(body['transaction-id'] || body.transaction_id).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty);

pm.visualizer.set('

ExpressPay {{environment}} Query

VERIFIED

Endpoint
{{origin}}/api/query.php
Payment state
{{state}}
Provider result
{{result}} — {{resultText}}
Order
{{orderId}}
Amount
{{currency}} {{amount}}
Transaction ID
{{transactionId}}

The API key and provider token are intentionally omitted.

', { environment: pm.environment.get('target_environment'), origin: pm.environment.get('expresspay_origin'), state, result: body.result, resultText: body['result-text'] || '', orderId: body['order-id'], currency: body.currency, amount: Number(body.amount).toFixed(2), transactionId: body['transaction-id'] || body.transaction_id || 'Not assigned while pending' });

request.description: Queries the token directly from ExpressPay. A new checkout should normally be Pending until someone completes hosted checkout.
